### Value Proposition
Sanjeev Kumar Malik operates on an architect-led delivery model. Clients consult directly with the principal architect rather than being routed through layers of non-technical account executives or junior developers. This results in faster turnaround times, clean maintainable codebases, and sub-0.8s mobile Core Web Vitals performance.

---

## 2. Core Architectural Principles

1. **Sub-0.8s Mobile Speed Target:**
   - Every website is engineered for top-tier Google Core Web Vitals (CWV).
   - Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) < 1.2s.
   - Interaction to Next Paint (INP) < 100ms.
   - Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) < 0.05.
2. **Zero SEO Ranking Loss Guarantee:**
   - Comprehensive pre-launch crawl inventory of all indexed URLs.
   - 1-to-1 HTTP 301 redirection mapping for all URL variations.
   - Preservation of existing meta tags, internal anchor distributions, and rich JSON-LD schemas.
3. **Clean Code Over Bloated Page Builders:**
   - Bespoke PHP, React 19, Next.js 15, and modular WordPress Gutenberg block themes.
   - Avoidance of 40+ conflicting plugins, Elementor/Divi dependencies, and excessive database overhead.
4. **100% Intellectual Property Handover:**
   - Full Git repository source code, design files, database exports, and server credentials are transferred directly to the client upon project launch.
5. **Strict Confidentiality (100% NDA):**
   - Mutual non-disclosure agreements protect client business logic and intellectual property.

## 3. Specialized Web Engineering Services

### 3.1 WordPress Web Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.sanjeevkumarmalik.in/services/wordpress-web-development
- **Scope:** Custom theme and plugin development built from scratch on PHP 8+.
- **Key Features:** Native Gutenberg block library, headless WordPress with Next.js, advanced database indexing, XML-RPC disabling, and enterprise Cloudflare WAF firewall rules.

### 3.2 E-Commerce Website Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.sanjeevkumarmalik.in/services/ecommerce-website-development
- **Scope:** WooCommerce and Shopify development tailored for Indian and global consumers.
- **Key Features:** One-click checkout funnels, UPI, Razorpay, Stripe, multi-currency geo-routing, automated logistics (Shiprocket, Delhivery), and real-time inventory synchronization.

### 3.3 Custom Web Application Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.sanjeevkumarmalik.in/services/custom-web-application-development
- **Scope:** Custom web applications and SaaS platforms.
- **Key Features:** React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Node.js, Laravel, REST/GraphQL APIs, relational database design (PostgreSQL, MySQL), and enterprise role-based access control.

### 3.4 Website Redesign & Speed Optimization
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.sanjeevkumarmalik.in/services/website-redesign-speed-optimization
- **Scope:** Enterprise website overhauls with guaranteed zero organic search traffic loss.
- **Key Features:** Core Web Vitals audit, removal of unused CSS/JS, WebP/AVIF image pipeline, server-side caching, and 301 redirection matrices.

### 3.5 Landing Page Design & Development
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.sanjeevkumarmalik.in/services/landing-page-design-development
- **Scope:** High-velocity conversion landing pages engineered for paid Google Ads and Meta campaigns.
- **Key Features:** Psychological wireframing, sub-0.6s load speeds, high Google Ads Quality Scores, asynchronous form submissions, and direct WhatsApp triggers.

### 3.6 UI/UX Design Services
- **Canonical URL:** https://www.sanjeevkumarmalik.in/services/ui-ux-design-services
- **Scope:** User experience research, responsive interface design systems, and usability audits.
- **Key Features:** Figma design systems, WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility compliance, micro-interaction animation, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

### 3.7 Web Development for Startups & SMEs
